text:
nina: FYI the polaris-int8 canary is passing JSON parse but failing schema checks for funcalls. We’re seeing numbers turned into strings in tool args (e.g. "42" instead of 42).

yusuf: Interesting — so not parse errors but type mismatches. How often?

nina: About 1.6% of funcall responses on the e2e funcall testset (5k samples). FP16 mirror is ~0.15%. Example: ```{"tool":"set_threshold","args": {"threshold": "3"}}``` expected threshold as number.

sasha: That smells like a generation bias around quoting. Could be quantization-induced tokenization boundary making the model prefer `"` + digits sequence. Any token-id diffs?

igor: Also check streaming vs non-streaming: streamed suffixes sometimes insert quotes when chunk boundaries cut mid-token. Worth checking if CB or streaming causes this.

yusuf: Run quick token diff and a streaming toggle mirror. If streaming reduces the issue, it’s likely a boundary emission artifact.

nina: Repro command used: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/invoke -d '{"model":"polaris-int8","prompt":"<funcall-number-types>","max_tokens":200}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'``` Ran 5000 reps, filtered where schema validation failed.

ci-bot: Canary polaris-int8 rolled to 40% at 3141599000 (alert threshold: 0.5% funcall-type-fail). Link: https://deploys.redwood/3141599000

igor: Quick mitigation: 1) enable a proxy pre-processor that coerces numeric-string args to numbers when schema expects numeric types (soft-fix), 2) disable continuous batching for canary pool and replay to fp16, 3) hold further rollout until quant-bisect.

yusuf: Agreed. Also add an onboard unit test that runs a set of typed-funcall prompts and asserts token-level generation around quotes/digits across quant recipes.

sasha: If coercion reduces user-facing errors <0.4%, we can keep the canary at reduced traffic while engine team bisects quant tables.

nina: Update (16m): disabling CB dropped type-mismatch to 0.28% on a 2k sample replay. Proxy coercion reduces effective failures to 0.06%. Filing incident and attaching token-id diffs for polaris v3.2 quant.

igor: Thanks — I’ll start the quant-bisect and check for any tokenizer-packing step that might have introduced quote-preferring merges.

nina: Filing incident now and adding links to the replay logs. Appreciated. :wave:
